resources.string: Get your iPhone screen into IVO LIVE
Ready. On the iPhone: Control Center › Screen Mirroring › %1$s
The iPhone is asking for the code: type %1$s on it.
Tap Start so this phone shows up in the iPhone\'s Screen Mirroring.
On the iPhone: Control Center › Screen Mirroring › %1$s
On the iPhone: Control Center › Screen Mirroring › %1$s. The first time it asks for the code %2$s.
Picture %1$d×%2$d · from the iPhone %3$d fps · to IVO LIVE %4$d fps
1440p. With the iPhone upright the picture is about twice as sharp. Heavier on this phone: if the report says \"decoder falling behind\", go back to Normal.
IVO LIVE always gets the same size; with the iPhone upright, the sides show a blurred copy of the picture. Turning the iPhone doesn\'t flicker or change the source\'s size.
Only someone who types the code on the iPhone can mirror. Each iPhone types it just once.
The receiver starts by itself when you open IVO Mirror. You can also start it from Android\'s quick settings.
Changes apply the next time it starts (tap Stop, then Start).
Both devices on the same Wi-Fi.
On the iPhone, open Control Center, tap Screen Mirroring and choose this phone.
In IVO LIVE (on this or another phone): + Source › Another phone › \"iPhone · …\".
The iPhone mirrors at about 30 frames per second; that\'s Apple\'s limit.
Open source (GPL-3.0) · version %1$s · tap to see the licenses
